name: Bear Trapper Turkey Sandwich or Plain Cheeseburger (Skip Cowboy Onion Rings)
brandOrRestaurant: Bear Trapper Steakhouse (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Sliced roast turkey on white/sourdough bread or a plain charbroiled cheeseburger with aged cheddar gives you a reliable lunch option when skipping the fried onion rings and smoky BBQ sauce on the Cowboy Burger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Sliced Turkey Sandwich on white or sourdough bread (no lettuce or tomato) or a plain Cheeseburger with cheddar—avoid the Cowboy Burger onion rings and BBQ sauce.
watchOuts: Skip deep-fried onion rings and raw tomato/lettuce
